title: CODA RAINY WINDOW (Neo-Soul × Lo-Fi DnB × Jazz Hop) [85]
style: neo-soul meets lo-fi drum and bass and jazz hop, 85 BPM with half-time DnB feel option, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English + French + te reo Maori, smoky Rhodes electric piano chords, dusty chopped breakbeats with vinyl crackle, walking upright bass with slides, soft tenor sax accents, jazz brushed snares, lo-fi tape hiss, rain and window-pane foley, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, late-night-rainy-window-introspection mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, listening-room 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(rain on window, vinyl crackle, Rhodes chord, soft sax)
(CO... DA... rai... ny... win... dow...)
(la... pluie... la... pluie...)
(te... ua... te... ua...)

[Build]
(brushed snare locks in, walking bass enters)
CO — DA! RAI — NY!
LA — PLUIE! LA — PLUIE!
TE — UA! TE — UA!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(sax phrase, soft riser)

[Drop 1]
(half-time DnB break with brushes, Rhodes lead, sub)
RAI — NY!
WIN — DOW!
LET — IT — RAIN!
QUI — ET!
(chop stack +7) yes-yes-oui-oui / āe-āe-yes-yes
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(sax solo phrase, walking bass, chops trade)
(hear it?) (tu entends?) (kei te rongo?)
(yes!) (oui!) (āe!)
(stay!) (reste!) (nōho!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE QUIET —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to Rhodes + rain alone, no drums)
(whispered) coda... rainy... window...
(soft) la pluie... la pluie...
(soft) te ua... te ua...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(brushed snare builds, DnB break returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time DnB break with brushes, full warm stack peak)
CO — DA — RAI — NY — WIN — DOW! (yes yes yes!)
LET — IT — RAIN! (oui oui oui!)
QUI — ET! (āe āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(DnB fades, sax resolves, rain holds)
(coda... rainy... window...)
(la pluie... te ua...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(rain on window holds, fade to silence)
